items.title: National Youth Conference
items.summary: Our biggest gathering of the year, bringing young people together from across the chapters for worship, teaching and a bigger vision of what their lives can become.

items.title: Day of Prayer and Fasting
items.summary: A day set aside across all our chapters to pray for our students, our volunteers and the schools that keep their doors open to us.

items.title: Volunteer Appreciation and Donor Night
items.summary: An evening to honour the volunteers who carry this work week after week, and to stand alongside the partners and donors who make it possible.

items.title: Annual Prayer and Vision Night
items.summary: We close the year together in worship and thanksgiving, share what has happened across the chapters, and look ahead to the year to come.
